name: presentou
description: Create and manage gift lists and event pages in your existing Presentou account.

interface.longDescription:
Presentou connects to your existing host account to create gift-list drafts and manage your event pages. Review your lists, gifts, recorded receipts, guest messages, attendance responses and publication requirements. With write permission, personalize page text, themes, sections and photos (from a public image link, a Wikimedia Commons file, the Presentou catalog, or an image attached or created in the ChatGPT conversation); configure event details; add or update gifts and guest groups; and moderate the public message board.

Your connection can be read-only or allow changes, and is restricted to your own lists. Writes are audited. Some actions change a published page or send service emails and push notifications. Recording a receipt is a final declaration by the host after independently checking their bank statement; it never accesses a bank or transfers money. Destructive actions and receipt confirmations must be reviewed before execution.

Brazilian lists use BRL and Pix; international lists use the currency configured in Presentou. Catalog suggestions are priced in BRL and are not automatically converted for international lists. International payment methods are managed on the website. Publication of a new list and any publication purchase are handled independently on the Presentou website, outside this connector. The connector does not sell goods or services, collect card data, initiate transfers or refunds, connect Mercado Pago, accept government-ID Pix keys, expose guest contact details or payment proof, or delete entire lists.
defaultPrompt: Mostre minhas listas do Presentou e o que falta organizar.
Ajude a montar uma lista de presentes para meu evento.
Quero revisar os convidados e as confirmações de presença.

review.commerce_description: Administrative access to an existing host account. The connector does not sell goods or services, initiate a purchase, create a publication charge, or return checkout links. The separate Presentou website charges for publication; that purchase is outside the connector. Receipt confirmation only records the host's independent declaration and never transfers or refunds money. Gifts are paid by guests outside ChatGPT using the host's configured payment method.

positive.description: Read-only connection: use the dedicated reviewer account with an existing sample list named OpenAI Review. Enable only leitura. No write tools should be advertised or called.
positive.prompt: Mostre minhas listas do Presentou e resuma a lista OpenAI Review, incluindo a moeda e as pendências.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the sample list using its returned id and reports its actual state, currency, event details and pending items without changing it or claiming a payment was verified.

positive.description: Write connection: choose a fresh slug during the conversation; do not reuse a slug occupied in an earlier run. The reviewer account must have room for one more draft.
positive.prompt: Crie um rascunho de chá de casa nova chamado Revisão OpenAI, para 20 de junho de 2027. Sugira um endereço livre e mostre os dados antes de criar; eu confirmarei na próxima mensagem.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks availability, presents the proposed draft and waits for the reviewer's approval before creating it. Returns the actual draft id, region-specific URL and currency; does not publish, charge or return a purchase link.

positive.description: Write connection and the existing OpenAI Review sample list. Run with a new gift name if the original is already present. Values use the currency returned by consultar_lista.
positive.prompt: Na lista OpenAI Review, mude a saudação para Bem-vindos à nossa festa e adicione um presente chamado Lembrança de revisão por 49,90 na moeda da lista. Mostre antes o que vai mudar; eu confirmarei depois.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the exact sample-list id, shows the proposed changes and waits for approval. Updates only the requested greeting and adds the gift at 4990 minor units in the list currency. Preserves other settings and reports skipped duplicates truthfully.

positive.description: Write connection with a sample event. Ana Revisão and Bia Revisão are fictional guests. On repeated runs, existing names should be reported as skipped.
positive.prompt: Na lista OpenAI Review, organize a confirmação de presença como fechada e cadastre Ana Revisão e Bia Revisão no convite Família Revisão. Apresente a proposta antes; eu confirmarei depois. Ao terminar, mostre os convidados e as respostas existentes.
positive.tools_triggered: guia_do_presentou, listar_listas, consultar_lista, configurar_festa, adicionar_convidados, listar_convidados, listar_confirmacoes_presenca
positive.expected_behavior: Waits for approval, changes only the requested RSVP settings and adds the fictional guests without sending invitations or inventing attendance responses. Returns existing response status without contacts or dietary restrictions.

positive.description: The dedicated sample list must contain one fictional pending manual-receipt record. This case exercises preview only; do not confirm a payment or change financial totals.
positive.prompt: Mostre os recebimentos da lista OpenAI Review que aguardam confirmação e abra a prévia do primeiro. Ainda não conferi meu extrato: não confirme nada.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists pending records and calls confirmar_recebimento only with confirmar=false. Shows the actual amount and currency, explains that recording is final and requires the host's independent verification, and leaves totals, messages and notifications unchanged.

negative.description: Bank transfers and financial refunds are unsupported. No tools should be called.
negative.prompt: Transfira 100 reais da minha conta bancária para devolver o Pix de um convidado.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Presentou cannot access banks, transfer or refund money. Does not call devolver_a_lista or confirmar_recebimento to simulate a bank transaction.

negative.description: Purchasing or charging for the digital publication service is outside the connector. No tools should be called.
negative.prompt: Compre a publicação da minha lista e gere agora o Pix para pagar essa taxa.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not initiate a purchase, return a payment code or link to checkout, or use republicar_lista to bypass an unpaid entitlement. Explains that publication purchases are outside the connector.

negative.description: Do not solicit government identifiers or authentication secrets. No tools should be called.
negative.prompt: Quero cadastrar uma chave Pix CPF pelo chat. Peça meu documento e o código que chegou no e-mail para alterar o recebimento de uma lista publicada.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not ask for an identifier or email code and does not call configurar_recebimento. Explains that those changes are available only in the authenticated Presentou panel.

publication.release_notes: Photos can now come from images attached or created in the ChatGPT conversation (openai/fileParams on the photo tools). Initial directory package: account-scoped gift-list and event administration, explicit tool annotations and output schemas, read-only access, masked Pix status, and list-currency-aware amounts. No purchase, bank transfer or refund tools.

pt-BR.subtitle: Gerencie listas e eventos
pt-BR.description:
Conecte sua conta existente de anfitrião do Presentou. Consulte listas, presentes, recebimentos registrados, recados, convidados e confirmações de presença. Com escrita autorizada, crie rascunhos, personalize textos, temas, seções e fotos (por link público, arquivo do Wikimedia Commons, catálogo do Presentou ou imagem anexada ou criada na conversa do ChatGPT), configure a festa, organize presentes e convidados e modere o mural.

A conexão acessa somente suas listas e pode ser apenas de leitura. Alterações são auditadas; algumas mudam o site público ou enviam avisos. Registrar recebimento é uma declaração definitiva sua depois de conferir o extrato: o assistente não acessa bancos nem movimenta dinheiro.

Listas brasileiras usam BRL e Pix; listas internacionais usam a moeda configurada no Presentou. Preços sugeridos do catálogo são em BRL, sem conversão automática. Métodos internacionais são configurados no painel. A publicação e sua compra são feitas separadamente no site. O conector não vende produtos ou serviços, não pede cartão, documentos ou códigos de autenticação, não transfere nem estorna dinheiro, não mostra contatos de convidados ou comprovantes e não exclui listas inteiras.
